Damage to illusions is not reflected. Damage reflected is before reduction and non-lethal.
Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

abilities.name: queenofpain_succubus
abilities.desc_loc: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is %close_radius% units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is %max_radius% units or further from her.

abilities.name: queenofpain_sonic_wave
abilities.desc_loc: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.
notes_loc: Sonic Wave can hit units up to 1150 units away.

abilities.name: earth_spirit_boulder_smash
abilities.desc_loc: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a %remnant_smash_radius_tooltip% radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits.  If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.

abilities.name: earth_spirit_rolling_boulder
abilities.desc_loc: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a %delay%s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing %damage% + %damage_str%%% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
notes_loc: Rolling over a Stone Remnant will destroy the Remnant.
The boulder has a radius of %radius%.
Earth Spirit is untargetable and invulnerable while rolling.

abilities.name: earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip
abilities.desc_loc:
Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.

Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.

Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.
notes_loc: Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Geomagnetic Grip can also target allied creeps.
abilities.shard_loc: Decreases cooldown to %AbilityCooldown%s and increases allied unit cast range and pull speed.

abilities.name: earth_spirit_stone_caller
abilities.desc_loc:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location. Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities. Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has %AbilityCharges% charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains %attack_damage_per_stone%%% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional %attack_damage_per_stone_used%%% bonus damage for %buff_duration%s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).

abilities.name: earth_spirit_petrify
abilities.desc_loc:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. < br>
Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.
Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.
notes_loc: Earth Spirit himself can be targeted by Boulder Smash if he is enchanted.

abilities.name: earth_spirit_magnetize
abilities.desc_loc: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.

abilities.name: sandking_burrowstrike
abilities.desc_loc:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
notes_loc: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: sandking_sand_storm
abilities.desc_loc: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
notes_loc: Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in %fade_delay% seconds.

abilities.name: sandking_scorpion_strike
abilities.desc_loc: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of %inner_radius% take %inner_radius_bonus_damage_pct%%% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
abilities.shard_loc: A Caustic Finale explosion that deals %caustic_damage_pct%%% damage is created around every enemy hero hit in Stinger's innermost radius. Does not apply to strikes created by Aghanim's Scepter upgrade.

abilities.name: sandking_caustic_finale
abilities.desc_loc: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.

abilities.name: sandking_epicenter
abilities.desc_loc: After a cast point of %abilitycastpoint% seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
notes_loc: The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.
abilities.shard_loc: Every %shard_interval%s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
abilities.scepter_loc: When the pulses start, %scepter_explosions_per_pulse% Stinger attack areas are created every %spine_tick_rate%s at random locations, each measuring %scepter_explosion_radius_pct%%% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply %spine_damage_pct%%% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause %shard_explosions_per_pulse% attack(s).

abilities.name: pangolier_swashbuckle
abilities.desc_loc:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
notes_loc: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.

abilities.name: pangolier_shield_crash
abilities.desc_loc:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
abilities.scepter_loc: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals %scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%% damage.

abilities.name: pangolier_lucky_shot
abilities.desc_loc: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.

abilities.name: pangolier_rollup
abilities.desc_loc: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.

abilities.name: pangolier_gyroshell
abilities.desc_loc:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_loc: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier %move_speed_ramp_up_time%s to reach full roll speed.

abilities.name: pangolier_fortune_favors_the_bold
abilities.desc_loc: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.
notes_loc: Applies to hero abilities and items.
Effect is a relative reduction in chance for effects to happen.

abilities.name: axe_berserkers_call
abilities.desc_loc: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
abilities.shard_loc: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.

abilities.name: axe_battle_hunger
abilities.desc_loc: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
notes_loc: Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.
abilities.shard_loc: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.

abilities.name: axe_counter_helix
abilities.desc_loc: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
notes_loc: Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.
abilities.scepter_loc: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.

abilities.name: axe_culling_blade
abilities.desc_loc:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
notes_loc: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.

abilities.name: axe_one_man_army
abilities.desc_loc: Axe gains Strength based on %armor_pct_as_strength%%% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within %radius% distance from Axe.  The effect fades over %bonus_linger_duration%s after approaching an ally.

abilities.name: disruptor_thunder_strike
abilities.desc_loc: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by %slow_amount%%% for %slow_duration% seconds.  Provides vision of its target.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to %shard_ground_delay% seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.

abilities.name: disruptor_glimpse
abilities.desc_loc: Teleports the target hero back to where it was %backtrack_time% seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
notes_loc: The travel time is a function of the distance the target will travel.

abilities.name: disruptor_kinetic_field
abilities.desc_loc: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
notes_loc: Debuff Immune units can travel through the field.
abilities.shard_loc: Both shapes have an independent cooldown.

abilities.name: disruptor_kinetic_fence
abilities.desc_loc: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.

abilities.name: disruptor_electromagnetic_repulsion
abilities.desc_loc: Whenever Disruptor takes more than %damage_threshold% damage from any source within %effect_radius% radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to %damage_per_int%x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a %effect_radius% distance away.
notes_loc: After %damage_reset_interval%s, the damage counter is reset.

abilities.name: disruptor_static_storm
abilities.desc_loc: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
abilities.scepter_loc: Mutes items.

abilities.name: riki_smoke_screen
abilities.desc_loc: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
notes_loc: Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
Doesn't prevent the use of active items.
abilities.shard_loc: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by %armor_reduction% and cannot be targeted by their allies.

abilities.name: riki_blink_strike
abilities.desc_loc: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by %slow_pct_tooltip%%% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.

abilities.name: riki_tricks_of_the_trade
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes %interval_targets% random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
abilities.scepter_loc: Increases Cast Range to %AbilityCastRange%. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have %scepter_movespeed%%% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts %scepter_bonus_duration%s longer and does an additional %scepter_bonus_attacks% attacks.

abilities.name: riki_innate_backstab
abilities.desc_loc: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.
notes_loc: Works when denying friendly units at %ally_multiplier%%% effectiveness.
Illusions of Riki will play Backstab animations, but not deal any bonus damage.

abilities.name: riki_backstab
abilities.desc_loc: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.

abilities.name: necrolyte_death_pulse
abilities.desc_loc: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
notes_loc: Death Pulse can't be disjointed.

abilities.name: necrolyte_ghost_shroud
abilities.desc_loc: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.

abilities.name: necrolyte_heartstopper_aura
abilities.desc_loc: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
notes_loc: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.
Does not affect ancient creeps.
abilities.scepter_loc: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by %heal_regen_to_damage%%% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.

abilities.name: necrolyte_death_seeker
abilities.desc_loc: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
notes_loc: Does not trigger spell reflect.

abilities.name: necrolyte_sadist
abilities.desc_loc: Necrophos gains stacking regen for %regen_duration% seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.
notes_loc: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

abilities.name: necrolyte_reapers_scythe
abilities.desc_loc: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
notes_loc: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.

abilities.name: leshrac_split_earth
abilities.desc_loc: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.
notes_loc: Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
There is a %delay% second delay before the effect is applied.

abilities.name: leshrac_diabolic_edict
abilities.desc_loc: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings.  The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.
notes_loc: The explosions will continue even if Leshrac is killed.

abilities.name: leshrac_lightning_storm
abilities.desc_loc: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.

abilities.name: leshrac_greater_lightning_storm
abilities.desc_loc: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.

abilities.name: leshrac_defilement
abilities.desc_loc: Leshrac gains %aoe_per_int% Area of Effect Bonus per Intelligence.

abilities.name: leshrac_pulse_nova
abilities.desc_loc: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.

abilities.name: night_stalker_void
abilities.desc_loc: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
notes_loc: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.

abilities.name: night_stalker_crippling_fear
abilities.desc_loc: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.

abilities.name: night_stalker_midnight_feast
abilities.desc_loc: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units. At night, the ability can be activated to instantly destroy a non-ancient creep and restore a percentage of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana.
notes_loc: Amount of health gained from attacking is affecting by Health Restoration and is decreased when attacking non-hero targets.

abilities.name: night_stalker_hunter_in_the_night
abilities.desc_loc: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.

abilities.name: night_stalker_darkness
abilities.desc_loc: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_spirit_lance
abilities.desc_loc: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
notes_loc: Illusions within %fake_lance_distance% range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_doppelwalk
abilities.desc_loc:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After %delay% second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes %illusion_2_damage_in_pct%%% bonus damage and deals %illusion_2_damage_out_pct%%% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_loc: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_phantom_edge
abilities.desc_loc: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
notes_loc: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
Rush movement speed is %bonus_speed%.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_illusory_armaments
abilities.desc_loc: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for %duration% seconds.

abilities.name: phantom_lancer_juxtapose
abilities.desc_loc: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for %illusion_duration% seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last %illusion_from_illusion_duration% seconds.

abilities.name: windrunner_shackleshot
abilities.desc_loc: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to %fail_stun_duration%.
notes_loc: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most %shackle_distance% behind the target.
Shackleshot can be disjointed.

abilities.name: windrunner_powershot
abilities.desc_loc: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
notes_loc: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.

abilities.name: windrunner_windrun
abilities.desc_loc: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.

abilities.name: windrunner_gale_force
abilities.desc_loc: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.

abilities.name: windrunner_focusfire
abilities.desc_loc: Windranger channels the wind to gain %bonus_attack_speed% additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
notes_loc: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
Windranger can move while attacking.

abilities.name: windrunner_tailwind
abilities.desc_loc:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.

abilities.name: dark_willow_bramble_maze
abilities.desc_loc: Dark Willow creates a %placement_range% AoE maze of %placement_count% brambles that grow in the target area after %initial_creation_delay% seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts %placement_duration% seconds.
notes_loc: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.

abilities.name: dark_willow_shadow_realm
abilities.desc_loc: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after %max_damage_duration% seconds.
notes_loc: Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
Grants phased movement.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.

abilities.name: dark_willow_cursed_crown
abilities.desc_loc: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.

abilities.name: dark_willow_bedlam
abilities.desc_loc: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.

abilities.name: dark_willow_pixie_dust
abilities.desc_loc: Dark Willow gains %hp_regen_amp%%% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to %hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

abilities.name: dark_willow_terrorize
abilities.desc_loc: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
notes_loc: Terrorize provides vision on affected units.

116.name: item_black_king_bar
116.desc_loc:
Active: Avatar

Applies a basic dispel. Grants %spell_reduce%%% magic resistance and immunity to reflected and pure damage. For the duration of the effect, any negative effect from enemy spells has no effect.

Duration: %duration%s
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes_loc: Purchasing another Black King Bar will not reset its immunity duration.
Avatar duration is not affected by increases to buff duration.

123.name: item_sphere
123.desc_loc:
Passive: Spellblock

Blocks most targeted spells once every %block_cooldown% seconds.

Active: Transfer Spellblock

Temporarily removes Spellblock from the item's owner and transfers it to an allied unit for %block_cooldown% seconds.
notes_loc: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Spellblock.

147.name: item_manta
147.desc_loc:
Active: Mirror Image

Creates %images_count% images of your hero that last %illusion_duration% seconds.

Melee images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_melee%%% damage, while Ranged images deal %tooltip_damage_outgoing_ranged%%%. Illusions take %tooltip_damage_incoming_total_pct%%% damage.

Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes_loc: Has a %invuln_duration% second cast time during which you are invulnerable.
Many effects are removed upon using Manta.
Yasha based movement speed bonuses from multiple items do not stack.

102.name: item_force_staff
102.desc_loc:
Active: Force

Pushes any target unit %push_length% units in the direction it is facing.
notes_loc: Self-cast will cause you to use Force on yourself.
Force Staff doesn't interrupt the target's actions.
Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Force Staff has %enemy_cast_range% cast range when cast on enemies.

254.name: item_glimmer_cape
254.desc_loc:
Active: Glimmer

After a %initial_fade_delay% second delay, grants invisibility, %active_movement_speed% movement speed and a magic damage barrier that absorbs up to %barrier_block% damage to you or a target allied unit for %duration% seconds.

Can be cast while channeling.

226.name: item_lotus_orb
226.desc_loc:
Active: Echo Shell

Applies a shield to the target unit for %active_duration% seconds which re-casts most targeted spells back to their caster.

The shielded unit will still take damage from the spell.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes_loc: Targeted abilities from neutral items do not trigger Echo Shell.

100.name: item_cyclone
100.desc_loc:
Active: Cyclone

Sweeps a target unit up into a cyclone, making them invulnerable for %cyclone_duration% seconds. Cyclone can only be cast on enemy units or yourself.

Enemy units take %tooltip_drop_damage% magical damage upon landing.
Dispel Type: Basic Dispel
notes_loc: You cannot cyclone allies.
Cyclones cast on yourself go through spell immunity.
Cyclone can dispel some buffs and debuffs.
Cyclone duration is unaffected by status resistance.
